title: Skydive Okanagan

services.name: Tandem
services.desc: Next, you will get geared up in the equipment provided: a special skydive jumpsuit and a para helmet. Then board the aircraft with your instructor and climb to jump altitude, from where you will launch your skydive! OFF WE GO! Within seconds you reach speeds of over 120 miles per hour in freefall. You will experience 30 seconds of freefall, at five thousand feet, you feel the gentle tug of the canopy opening. The next 5 to 10 minutes you float through the sky. The view over Vernon is breathtaking. During a peaceful parachute ride back to the Vernon airport you will soar over the lush orchards and vineyards that make up our beautiful valley.
